question: With the P3 carrier, the rooted branching-fragment objects, the training data, the recipe and the horizon held fixed, does replacing the dense content MLP by a shared-factor low-order (rank 32, up to third order) combination of the same per-slot content improve finite-sample generalisation?

scope.type: local content-parameterisation comparison; not a new backbone, not a claim of new structural information
scope.only_difference: the local content function phi; carrier, objects, permutation average, aggregation, port, recipe, horizon and selection are shared
scope.official_test_status: historically exposed benchmark; described once after the freeze, not a new blind test

data.target_transform: none (no clipping, reweighting or extra supervision)
data.normalization: frozen P3 train-only global-33 mean/scale (analysis/norm.json of zinc_arch_discovery_v1)
data.pretraining: frozen P3 train-only masked SSL encoders, no labels

families.F4: v-u plus two distinct w in N(u)\{v}, 4 nodes

objects.content: complete typed induced adjacency; atom category slots (5, vocab 28); 10 unordered pairs, 0 = no real edge, 1..3 = raw bond type; node_mask 5, pair_mask 10, family one-hot 3
objects.root: always slot 0; other real nodes may be permuted; padding after the real nodes
objects.multiplicity: one (root, family, actual node set) exactly once; equal content with different node sets keeps its count; families independent; empty family is the exact empty set
objects.pattern_id: static content-cache address only; never a learnable embedding; split-local, so cross-split work uses the content key
objects.cache_note: the .pt file sha256 in the previous round (287a26a9..., 8de445d1...) differs from a local rebuild by the embedded creation timestamp only; the payload digest above is byte-identical on both hosts
objects.erratum: root coverage is 56.62% (not 2.18%); high content coverage is not evidence of sufficient generalisation and is not re-audited here

permutation_average.definition: phi_bar(p) = mean over the (n-1)! root-preserving permutations of the real non-root slots of one shared phi, applied to atom and pair slots together
permutation_average.weighting: exact 1/K for the K real permutations, 0 on unused padding rows; a duplicate-row merge with exact weights must equal the full weighted average
permutation_average.status: internal symmetry of one model, not an ensemble; each physical object still contributes one multiplicity unit and 6/24 permutations are not counted as objects
permutation_average.implementation: static content-keyed index table, vectorised; phi is recomputed with autograd on every forward (no cached hidden states)

model.carrier: ad2_models.P3NullModel (encoders + Null grouping + group_composer + reader + global33)
model.port: s_v (198) -> Linear(198,128,bias=False) W_s, zero-initialised; a_v = Linear128->96(SiLU(Linear108->128(raw108_v) + W_s s_v))
model.aggregation: per root and family: occurrence-weighted mean(phi_bar) 32 + mean(phi_bar^2) 32 + log1p(true occurrence count) 1 + existence 1 = 66; three families = 198; mean_sq is taken after the permutation average; empty family is all zeros

D.phi: Linear 98->80 (bias) -> SiLU -> Linear 80->32 (bias); no dropout / LayerNorm / skip

F.phi: A: Linear 8->32 (bias) shared over atom slots; B: Linear 4->32 (bias) shared over pair slots; R_atom[5,32], R_pair[10,32] ~ Normal(0,0.1); f = mask*tanh(proj + role); channel-wise z1/z2/z3 over the m real fields; u = [z1,z2,z3,node_mask,pair_mask,family_onehot] (114); Linear 114->64 -> SiLU -> Linear 64->32; no dropout / LayerNorm / skip

moments.m: sum(node_mask) + sum(pair_mask) over real fields (10 for 4-node, 15 for 5-node)
moments.p1/p2/p3: channel-wise sums of f, f^2, f^3 over the real fields (padding is exactly 0 and never in the denominator)

forbidden_inits: A_joint_BF or any other trained checkpoint as a training start

ssl.composer_reader_init: fresh random init from torch.manual_seed(0), shared by both arms

optimizer.name: adamw
optimizer.parameter_groups: one group, all parameters, nothing frozen
optimizer.schedule: 500 outer updates linear warmup, then per-step cosine over the fixed 79*E-update horizon

schedule.selection: min valid MAE, strict <, ties keep the earlier epoch
schedule.epoch_reduction_rule: E=600 if 1.15*t_slow*600+120 <= 3600 s, otherwise E = min(600, 10*floor((3000/(1.15*t_slow))/10)); E<300 is a stop condition, not a licence for a longer job

time_plan.timing_includes: permutation average, both moment orders, backward, full valid, logging
time_plan.formal_reset: rebuild from the same seeds (public core, shared embeddings, arm phi), new optimiser, new row-order generator
time_plan.parallel: D on res-gpu0, F on res-gpu1, one committed revision

reference.note: reference rows are descriptive only, reused from saved predictions/runs, not retrained; only F-D is a same-round contrast

groups.unseen: existing audited content-key aligned radius-2 signature flag
groups.usage: post-hoc description only; no new thresholds, no gating
